file.withPassword:
Xposer AI report credentials
================================

Report number: {{number}}
Password: {{password}}

IMPORTANT:
----------
1. Save these credentials in a secure location
2. You will need both credentials to track your report
3. These credentials cannot be recovered if lost
4. Do not share these credentials with anyone

Track your report at: {{trackUrl}}
Generated on: {{date}}

Security notice:
---------------
This report is submitted anonymously. No personal information is stored.

tour.howBody: You never enter a name or email. Credentials come first, and they are the only thing tying you to the report.
tour.passwordBody: Let us generate a strong one, or set your own if you would rather memorize it. Either way it is paired with a report number.
tour.saveBody: Nothing about you is stored, which also means lost credentials cannot be recovered or reset. Copy them somewhere safe.
tour.startBody: This creates your credentials and moves you on to picking a report type. Nothing is submitted yet.
tour.credentialsBody: Copy or download these now — you will need both to finish this report later and to track it afterwards.
tour.typesBody: Each category asks a different set of questions. Choose the closest fit — compliance can re-categorize it later if needed.
tour.nextBody: Fill in the form, submit, then follow progress and reply to questions using your credentials.

init.title: Start an anonymous report

init.howSteps: 1. Get credentials → 2. Select report type → 3. Fill in the form → 4. Submit

init.saveBody: You will receive a unique report number and password. Save these immediately — you'll need them to continue and track your report. They cannot be recovered if lost.
